$comment: End-to-end journeys (QA task 9). A journey is an ordered list of steps; the runner expands each journey by its variants into runs. Step ids are implemented in apps/api/test/e2e/journeys/steps.ts and checked against this list by a unit test. Add journeys here; the runner needs no change unless a step is new.

role.description: Who is looking at the data after the admin has created it.

text.description: A name or title from tools/quality/unicode-fixtures.json (the 'valid' list): emoji, accents in two forms, right-to-left scripts, joiners.

steps.workspace.signup: A new workspace with its admin signed in.
steps.session.read: The admin reads the session and sees their own workspace.
steps.actor.choose: The person looking is the admin, or a member with exactly the role's grants.
steps.contact.create: The admin creates a contact whose name is the text variant.
steps.contact.read-as-actor: The actor reads that contact by id; the role decides whether they may.
steps.contact.search-as-actor: The actor searches contacts by the first three characters of the name; the role decides what they see.
steps.tag.create: The admin creates a tag whose name is the text variant.
steps.tag.attach: The admin attaches the tag to the contact.
steps.tag.list-on-contact: The tags on the contact include that tag, as typed.
steps.company.create: The admin creates a company whose name is the text variant.
steps.company.find: The admin finds the company by search.
steps.task.create: The admin creates a task whose title is the text variant.
steps.task.find: The admin finds the task by search.

journeys.title: A new workspace records its first contact and finds it again
A teammate sees the contact the admin created, according to their role
The admin tags a contact and the tag comes back exactly as typed
A company is created and found by search
A follow-up task is created and found by search
